senses.gloss:
शौद्धाक्षर शौद्धाक्षर, अस्, m., scil. सन्-
धि, epithet of a particular Sandhi, (viz. the insertion
of श् before चन्द्र, e. g. पुरु-श्-चन्द्र; of ष् be-
fore कृ, e. g. परि-ष्-कृण्वन्, &c.)

शौद्धोदनि शौद्धोदनि, इस्, m. (fr. शुद्धो-
दन), ‘son of Śuddhodana,’ a patronymic of the
great Buddha (founder of the Buddhist religion, see
बुद्ध).

शौद्र शौद्र, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. शूद्र), servile,
relating or belonging to the Śūdra or lowest tribe;
(अस्), m. the son of a man of either of the first three
classes by a Śūdra woman, (the last of the twelve
kinds of sons acknowledged in the ancient Hindū
law.)

सौदर्य सौदर्य, अम्, n. (fr. सोदर), bro-
therhood; (अस्, आ, अम्), having brotherhood with
(at the end of a comp.).

सौदामनी सौदामनी, f. (fr. सु-दामन्),
lightning or a particular kind of lightning; N. of
an Apsaras of Indra's heaven; of part of the Su-
dāman mountain (according to some).

सौदायिक सौदायिक, अस्, ई, अम्, (fr. सु-दाय),
that which is given to a woman at her marriage by
her father or mother or any relative and which there-
fore becomes her own property; relating to such a
present; (अम्), n. a nuptial gift or present (as de-
scribed above).

सौदास सौदास, अस्, m. (fr. सु-दास), N. of
a king of the solar race (a descendant of Ikṣvāku
and Sagara in the thirteenth generation, son of king
Su-dāsa, and also called Mitra-saha and Kalmāṣa-
pāda).
